'Her books bring me joy, make me smile, and make life and our current world just that bit more manageable…Escaping into the worlds she creates feels like a comfort and balm for any book reader's soul' ★★★★★

You don’t know what you’ve got till it’s gone…

Bets Fowler has always been perfectly fine living her life firmly within the borders of her tiny village. But when her ex, Jack, returns and is suddenly everywhere she goes, she realises just how small the parameters of her existence have become, and starts to step outside her comfort zone.

Jack Ashcroft has always sought out a bigger life than he thought Wilsgrave could afford, but when a knockback sends him home, and back into Bets’ orbit, he comes to see that the world he once inhabited has a lot more to offer than he ever realised, and that leaving might have been the biggest mistake he ever made.

Now, as Bets and Jack find themselves thrown together at every turn, the exes see what was and what could be in an entirely new light…

About the author

Julie Caplin is the international bestselling author of the Romantic Escapes series. Her books have hit the top of the bestseller charts in Germany, Italy, Iceland, Holland, the UK and the Czech Republic and have sold over a million copies worldwide. Her uplifting romantic comedies are set in gorgeous destinations across the globe, providing her readers with the ultimate escape.

Julie also writes romantic and historical fiction as Jules Wake.
